key_modifications: Replaced manual filter parameter extraction with FilterConfig objects
Consolidated search logic (3 fields) into single search filter configuration
Replaced explicit if-statement filtering with apply_list_filters utility call
Updated context dictionary to use returned result structure
Removed manual pagination code in favor of utility-handled pagination

patterns_discovered.description: Migration from imperative filtering (if-statements) to declarative FilterConfig objects
patterns_discovered.benefit: Improves maintainability and reduces code duplication across views

patterns_discovered.description: Three separate manual filter conditions replaced with single search FilterConfig supporting multiple fields
Pagination logic abstracted into apply_list_filters utility, eliminating repetitive Paginator calls
patterns_discovered.previous_pattern: Manual Paginator instantiation and get_page call

patterns_discovered.description: Utility returns structured dictionary with queryset and filter_values, standardizing data flow

gotchas_discovered.description: Filter parameter names in FilterConfig ('order') differ from context variable names ('order_filter')
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Explicitly mapped result['filter_values'].get('order') to context 'order_filter' key
gotchas_discovered.potential_issue: Easy to miss when context expectations differ from filter parameter names

gotchas_discovered.description: Context structure changed from direct variables (search, status_filter) to nested access pattern
gotchas_discovered.note: Templates must reference result['filter_values'] values correctly or use explicit mapping

gotchas_discovered.description: select_related and prefetch_related must be applied before passing to apply_list_filters
gotchas_discovered.note: Ordering of QuerySet optimization calls is critical for performance

approach_outcome.code_reduction: ~27% reduction in function body (32 lines to ~24 lines net change)
technical_improvements: Eliminated code duplication by using utility function
Improved readability through declarative filter definitions
Maintained existing functionality while reducing complexity
Preserved QuerySet optimization with select_related and prefetch_related
approach_outcome.testing_impact: Views should maintain identical output for same inputs

recommendations.recommendation: Create a mapping dictionary for filter parameter names to context variable names to prevent naming mismatches
Audit other view functions (bin_history likely next) for similar refactoring opportunities to apply_list_filters
recommendations.note: Pattern is reusable across multiple list views

recommendations.recommendation: Document FilterConfig expected structure and apply_list_filters return format for developer reference
recommendations.rationale: Reduces onboarding time for new developers and prevents configuration errors

recommendations.recommendation: Add integration tests verifying filter combinations (search + status + order together) work correctly
recommendations.note: Utility function correctness is critical since multiple views depend on it

recommendations.recommendation: Consider template updates to use consistent filter value access pattern across all filtered views
recommendations.note: Would require coordinated template changes across codebase
